globalVerdict: The answers strengthen standard algebraic, operational and incidence layers, but none derives the physical carrier, local dynamics, chirality preference, vacuum or spectrum required for programme closure.

established: A positive rank-two Euclidean Jordan algebra with a complete primitive frame and one-dimensional real off-diagonal Peirce space is H_2(R).
Its effective inner TKK algebra is sp(4,R), while H_2(C) gives the neighboring su(2,2) case.
conditional: The zero-coupling iso(2,2) and literal Q-map closure identifications require a dedicated convention-matched certificate.
open: Why the programme's recursion selects this carrier rather than a neighboring Jordan or triple-system closure.
letters.programmeEffect: Create a finite carrier certificate before making physical claims.

established: The TKK 3+4+3 grading is distinct from compact, holomorphic and contact gradings.
The same group acts as the 2+1-dimensional conformal group and as linear canonical transformations of four-dimensional phase space.
conditional: Calling either realization the programme's spacetime requires an explicit identification map and observables.
open: A Hamiltonian or covariant action that selects the physical realization.
letters.programmeEffect: Keep conformal-spacetime and phase-space readings separate until dynamics selects one.

established: Separate-factor actions on F⊗S commute tautologically.
A single irreducible real Spin(2,3) spinor has scalar commutant.
conditional: Orthogonal-symplectic dual-pair and osp(n|4) Clifford-Weyl constructions require enlarged modules.
A left-octonionic chain algebra may exhaust End_R(O), depending on the represented Furey module.
open: The actual commutant, ideal projection, grading and chirality on the programme's Furey representation.
letters.programmeEffect: Replace abstract compatibility discussion by an explicit matrix commutant calculation.

established: H_2(R) supports normalized rebit states, effects, real completely positive instruments and O(2) reversible dynamics.
Standard real-Hilbert composition admits interactions but fails local tomography and is bilocally tomographic.
conditional: A locally tomographic disk GPT can be chosen, but under the standard continuous symmetry assumptions it loses nontrivial continuous reversible interactions.
open: Which composite rule and operational meaning of the programme's two currents are intended.
letters.programmeEffect: Make the composite rule an explicit fork and test it experimentally before spacetime promotion.

established: Quadratic bosonic observables realize sp(4,R) metaplectically and preserve symplectic spectral invariants and positivity.
A generic quadratic embedding is not a Jordan homomorphism because anticommutators generate quartic terms.
conditional: Singleton constructions may recover spacetime fields only after translations, locality and a field reconstruction are supplied.
open: A faithful 3+1 Poincare/local-field interpretation; finite positive-frequency truncations cannot satisfy exact microcausality.
letters.programmeEffect: Use metaplectic mechanics as a controlled laboratory, not as the claimed local spacetime theory.

established: With the stated complex-plane and reality data, symplectic twistor geometry reconstructs an oriented Lorentzian AdS4 conformal structure and Weyl-spinor pair.
conditional: The result depends on retaining the complex plane, reality condition, cover and orientation data.
open: No Spin(2,3)-invariant chiral projector or physical preference between the two Weyl sectors is thereby selected.
letters.programmeEffect: Separate geometric orientation from a dynamical chirality-selection claim.

established: The real boundary incidence RP^3↔Lag(2,R^4) is exact.
conditional: Lorentzian AdS4 bulk points use complex planes with an appropriate Hermitian reality condition, not arbitrary real two-planes.
Bulk reconstruction requires a field equation, boundary condition, trace-range theorem and treatment of homogeneous data.
open: Positivity and locality require a specified CCR/commutator, spectrum condition and microlocal wavefront control.
letters.programmeEffect: Run a scalar reconstruction benchmark before higher-spin or quantum claims.

established: A finite internal spectral triple can be tensored with a four-dimensional spin geometry and can couple to a Cartan/gravitational sector.
A noncompact Sp(4,R) is not a conventional internal unitary group of a finite real C*-algebra on a positive Hilbert space.
conditional: Order-zero, first-order, bounded-commutator and signature conditions depend on the explicit representation and product chosen.
open: An explicit (A_F,H_F,D_F,J_F,γ_F), fluctuated action, stationary vacuum, healthy spectrum and RG matching.
letters.programmeEffect: Promote only a fully specified finite-triple/action packet.
